opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); Grants of up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 for Adelphi co‑sponsored award; Grants up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: open to PhD students and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based for conferences outside the UK, and must present a poster or talk.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences) by providing travel, accommodation and registration funding.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course is in the UK. Students need a supervisor letter; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short formal training courses or collaborative visits to learn specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK). Students need a supervisor letter. One grant per research group per 12 months and one per applicant per 2 years.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel, accommodation and related costs for field‑based genetic research projects that aim for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering eligible travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of the age of the person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: Offers up to £60 per day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings or events.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: up to several thousand pounds (major sponsorship levels between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society can apply to sponsor genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for one‑off genetics meetings, covering travel, accommodation, speaker costs and may include a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Groups wishing to run a regular series of genetics meetings can apply to become a new Special Interest Group; applications must be submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £2,000 annually to support the establishment and running of new Special Interest Groups that organise regular genetics‑focused meetings.
